# PowerPlay v1.3.7 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Added Settings → PowerLink pairing with a single-use nine-digit code and authenticated discovery of registered Fire Sticks.
- Added an in-player PowerLink icon to select a destination and initiate a room-to-room handoff with the remote.
- Supported transfers of imported queues, protected long wake routines, and HD/4K matching while pausing the source only after destination confirmation.

## Compatibility

In-player PowerLink pairing and handoff require [PowerLink HACS v0.2.0](https://github.com/The-Power-0/PowerLink/releases/tag/v0.2.0).
